environment.description: Tekton pipeline task running in a rootless Podman container with a pivot_root into a minimal chroot at /var/task/root. The chroot bind-mounts only /pipeline/logs (writable) and /pipeline/bin (read-only, contains the validator script). The /pipeline/secrets path is mapped to an empty tmpfs volume with 0 bytes capacity — the directory exists but cannot contain files. Secrets are injected exclusively via environment variable DEPLOY_TOKEN_HASH (a pre-computed SHA-256 hash) which the plugin does NOT read (it only reads from filesystem). The container's seccomp profile (based on containers/common restricted profile) additionally blocks clock_nanosleep, nanosleep, and clock_gettime syscalls beyond a coarsened 100ms granularity vDSO. Container has no network interfaces (network namespace with only loopback, and iptables DROP on lo for non-localhost). Response metadata is stripped by the Tekton result sidecar which only passes the boolean 'proceed' field.

config.secrets_dir: /pipeline/secrets is empty tmpfs (0 byte quota, cannot write files)
config.seccomp_additions: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on clock_nanosleep, nanosleep; clock_gettime returns coarsened 100ms resolution
config.network: isolated network namespace, no external interfaces, loopback only with DROP policy
config.response_filtering: Tekton result sidecar strips duration_ns from output, only passes proceed boolean
config.secrets_injection: via env var DEPLOY_TOKEN_HASH, not consumed by this code path
